description: How much baking soda raises your pool's total alkalinity, or how much muriatic acid or dry acid lowers it, for your pool size, using published doses per 10,000 gallons. Formula: Batches = |target − current| ÷ 10 × gallons ÷ 10,000. Raise: baking soda (lb) = batches × 1.4. Lower: muriatic acid 31.4% (fl oz) = batches × 26, or sodium bisulfate (lb) = batches × 2.1. Additions: raise no more than about 50 ppm at a time; add no more than 1 quart of acid per 10,000 gallons at a time.

target_ppm.description: Target total alkalinity (from your pool builder or test kit guide) (ppm); default 100
